<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>WifiCafé — Menú</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@400;600;700&family=Barlow:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --gold: #F5A800;
    --gold2: #FFD060;
    --gold-dim: #7A5200;
    --bg: #080808;
    --bg2: #111111;
    --bg3: #1C1C1C;
    --card: #161616;
    --border: #2A2A2A;
    --white: #F0EDE8;
    --gray: #888;
    --gray2: #555;
  }

- { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
background: var(–bg);
color: var(–white);
font-family: ‘Barlow’, sans-serif;
min-height: 100vh;
overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* ── Grain overlay ── */
body::before {
content: ‘’;
position: fixed; inset: 0;
background-image: url(“data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox=‘0 0 256 256’ xmlns=‘http://www.w3.org/2000/svg’%3E%3Cfilter id=‘noise’%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=‘fractalNoise’ baseFrequency=‘0.9’ numOctaves=‘4’ stitchTiles=‘stitch’/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=‘100%25’ height=‘100%25’ filter=‘url(%23noise)’ opacity=‘0.04’/%3E%3C/svg%3E”);
pointer-events: none;
z-index: 0;
opacity: .5;
}

/* ── HEADER ── */
header {
position: relative;
text-align: center;
padding: 48px 20px 36px;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(–border);
overflow: hidden;
}

header::after {
content: ‘’;
position: absolute;
bottom: -1px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
width: 120px; height: 2px;
background: var(–gold);
}

.glow-ring {
position: absolute;
top: -80px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
width: 320px; height: 200px;
background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(245,168,0,.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
pointer-events: none;
}

.logo-wrap {
display: inline-block;
animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes float {
0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); }
50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
}

.logo-mark {
width: 72px; height: 72px;
background: var(–gold);
clip-path: polygon(8% 10%, 92% 10%, 100% 20%, 100% 95%, 0% 95%, 0% 20%);
display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
margin: 0 auto 14px;
position: relative;
box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(245,168,0,.35);
}
.logo-mark::before {
content: ‘’;
position: absolute;
top: -14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
width: 18px; height: 18px;
background: var(–gold2);
clip-path: polygon(40% 0%, 55% 0%, 70% 100%, 25% 100%);
filter: blur(1px);
}
.logo-mark span {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: 14px;
color: #000;
letter-spacing: 1px;
line-height: 1;
text-align: center;
}

h1 {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: clamp(42px, 10vw, 72px);
letter-spacing: 4px;
line-height: 1;
background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(–gold2) 0%, var(–gold) 60%);
-webkit-background-clip: text;
-webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
background-clip: text;
margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.tagline {
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-size: 13px;
letter-spacing: 5px;
color: var(–gray);
text-transform: uppercase;
margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.contact-bar {
display: flex; gap: 20px; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
font-size: 12px; color: var(–gray);
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
letter-spacing: 2px;
}
.contact-bar a { color: var(–gold); text-decoration: none; }

/* ── PROTEINS BADGE ── */
.proteins-section {
background: var(–bg2);
border-bottom: 1px solid var(–border);
padding: 14px 20px;
text-align: center;
}
.proteins-label {
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-size: 10px;
letter-spacing: 4px;
color: var(–gold-dim);
text-transform: uppercase;
margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.proteins-list {
display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center;
}
.protein-tag {
background: transparent;
border: 1px solid var(–gold-dim);
color: var(–gold2);
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-size: 11px;
letter-spacing: 1px;
padding: 3px 10px;
border-radius: 2px;
transition: all .2s;
cursor: default;
}
.protein-tag:hover {
background: var(–gold);
border-color: var(–gold);
color: #000;
transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ── NAV TABS ── */
.nav-wrap {
position: sticky;
top: 0; z-index: 100;
background: rgba(8,8,8,.95);
backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
border-bottom: 1px solid var(–border);
}

.nav-tabs {
display: flex;
overflow-x: auto;
padding: 0 12px;
gap: 2px;
scrollbar-width: none;
}
.nav-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

.nav-tab {
flex-shrink: 0;
background: none; border: none;
color: var(–gray2);
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-size: 13px;
font-weight: 600;
letter-spacing: 1.5px;
text-transform: uppercase;
padding: 14px 14px;
cursor: pointer;
position: relative;
transition: color .2s;
white-space: nowrap;
}
.nav-tab::after {
content: ‘’;
position: absolute;
bottom: 0; left: 50%; right: 50%;
height: 2px;
background: var(–gold);
transition: left .25s, right .25s;
}
.nav-tab.active { color: var(–gold); }
.nav-tab.active::after { left: 0; right: 0; }
.nav-tab:hover:not(.active) { color: var(–white); }

/* ── MAIN CONTENT ── */
main { max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 14px 60px; }

/* ── SECTION ── */
.section { display: none; animation: fadeUp .35s ease; }
.section.active { display: block; }

@keyframes fadeUp {
from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.section-header {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
padding: 28px 0 16px;
}
.section-icon { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; }
.section-title {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: 32px;
letter-spacing: 3px;
color: var(–gold);
}
.section-note {
font-size: 12px;
color: var(–gray);
margin: -10px 0 16px;
padding: 10px 14px;
border-left: 2px solid var(–gold-dim);
font-style: italic;
line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── MENU ITEM ── */
.menu-item {
display: flex;
align-items: flex-start;
justify-content: space-between;
padding: 14px 0;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(–border);
gap: 12px;
transition: background .15s;
cursor: default;
}
.menu-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.015); margin: 0 -8px; padding-left: 8px; padding-right: 8px; border-radius: 4px; }
.menu-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

.item-info { flex: 1; }
.item-name {
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-weight: 700;
font-size: 16px;
letter-spacing: .5px;
color: var(–white);
line-height: 1.2;
margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.item-desc {
font-size: 12px;
color: var(–gray);
line-height: 1.4;
font-weight: 300;
}
.item-price {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: 20px;
letter-spacing: 1px;
color: var(–gold);
white-space: nowrap;
padding-top: 1px;
}

/* ── COMBO CARD ── */
.combo-card {
background: var(–card);
border: 1px solid var(–gold-dim);
border-radius: 8px;
padding: 18px 20px;
margin-bottom: 14px;
position: relative;
overflow: hidden;
transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.combo-card::before {
content: ‘’;
position: absolute;
top: 0; left: 0;
width: 3px; height: 100%;
background: var(–gold);
}
.combo-card:hover {
border-color: var(–gold);
box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(245,168,0,.1);
}
.combo-badge {
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-size: 10px;
letter-spacing: 3px;
color: var(–gold);
text-transform: uppercase;
margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.combo-name {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: 22px;
letter-spacing: 2px;
color: var(–white);
margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.combo-includes {
font-size: 12px;
color: var(–gray);
line-height: 1.7;
}
.combo-includes span {
display: block;
padding-left: 14px;
position: relative;
}
.combo-includes span::before {
content: ‘✓’;
position: absolute; left: 0;
color: var(–gold);
font-size: 11px;
}
.combo-price {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: 30px;
color: var(–gold);
letter-spacing: 2px;
margin-top: 12px;
}

/* ── ADICIONALES GRID ── */
.grid-2 {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
gap: 8px;
margin-top: 8px;
}
.add-item {
background: var(–bg3);
border: 1px solid var(–border);
border-radius: 6px;
padding: 10px 14px;
display: flex;
justify-content: space-between;
align-items: center;
transition: all .2s;
}
.add-item:hover {
border-color: var(–gold-dim);
background: var(–card);
transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.add-name {
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-weight: 600;
font-size: 14px;
color: var(–white);
}
.add-price {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: 16px;
color: var(–gold);
}

/* ── BEBIDAS ── */
.drink-item {
display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
padding: 12px 16px;
background: var(–bg2);
border-radius: 6px;
margin-bottom: 6px;
border: 1px solid transparent;
transition: all .2s;
}
.drink-item:hover {
border-color: var(–border);
background: var(–card);
}
.drink-name {
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
font-weight: 600;
font-size: 15px;
color: var(–white);
}
.drink-price {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, cursive;
font-size: 18px;
color: var(–gold);
}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
footer {
text-align: center;
padding: 30px 20px;
border-top: 1px solid var(–border);
color: var(–gray2);
font-size: 12px;
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
letter-spacing: 2px;
}
footer strong { color: var(–gold); }

/* ── Scroll indicator ── */
.scroll-hint {
text-align: center;
font-size: 11px;
color: var(–gray2);
padding: 6px;
letter-spacing: 1px;
font-family: ‘Barlow Condensed’, sans-serif;
}
</style>

</head>
<body>

<!-- HEADER -->

<header>
  <div class="glow-ring"></div>
  <div class="logo-wrap">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="WifiCafé" style="width:90px;height:90px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(245,168,0,.5));">
  </div>
  <h1>WifiCafé</h1>
  <p class="tagline">Comida Rica · Señal Fuerte</p>
  <div class="contact-bar">
    <span><a href="https://instagram.com/wificafesc">@wificafesc</a></span>
    <span>·</span>
    <span>0424-712.6151</span>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- PROTEÍNAS -->

<div class="proteins-section">
  <p class="proteins-label">Proteínas disponibles</p>
  <div class="proteins-list">
    <span class="protein-tag">Pollo Crispy</span>
    <span class="protein-tag">Carne Mechada</span>
    <span class="protein-tag">Pollo Mechado</span>
    <span class="protein-tag">Lomo de Cerdo</span>
    <span class="protein-tag">Milanesa de Pollo</span>
    <span class="protein-tag">Tocineta</span>
    <span class="protein-tag">Chorizo</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- NAV -->

<div class="nav-wrap">
  <div class="scroll-hint">← desliza →</div>
  <nav class="nav-tabs" role="tablist">
    <button class="nav-tab active" onclick="show('cachapas',this)">🌽 Cachapas</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('burgers',this)">🍔 Hamburguesas</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('hotdogs',this)">🌭 Perros</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('burritos',this)">🌯 Burritos</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('morocho',this)">🥗 Morocho</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('especiales',this)">⭐ Especiales</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('papas',this)">🍟 Papas</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('combos',this)">🔥 Combos</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('adicionales',this)">➕ Adicionales</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" onclick="show('bebidas',this)">🥤 Bebidas</button>
  </nav>
</div>

<main>

  <!-- CACHAPAS -->

  <section class="section active" id="cachapas">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="section-icon">🌽</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Cachapas</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Queso Mozzarella</div></div><div class="item-price">13.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Queso Mozzarella + Jamón</div></div><div class="item-price">15.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Mozzarella + Jamón</div><div class="item-desc">+ 1 Proteína a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">22.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Mozzarella + Jamón</div><div class="item-desc">+ 2 Proteínas a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">27.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Mozzarella + Jamón</div><div class="item-desc">+ 3 Proteínas a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">34.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item" style="border-top: 1px solid var(--gold-dim); margin-top:10px; padding-top:18px;"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Queso de Mano</div></div><div class="item-price">18.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Queso de Mano + Jamón</div></div><div class="item-price">20.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Queso de Mano + Jamón</div><div class="item-desc">+ 1 Proteína a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">27.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Queso de Mano + Jamón</div><div class="item-desc">+ 2 Proteínas a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">32.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Queso de Mano + Jamón</div><div class="item-desc">+ 3 Proteínas a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">40.000$</div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- HAMBURGUESAS -->

  <section class="section" id="burgers">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="section-icon">🍔</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Hamburguesas</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Wi-Fi Croqueta</div></div><div class="item-price">13.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Wi-Fi Doble Croqueta + Queso Fundido</div></div><div class="item-price">19.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Wi-Fi Pollo Crispy</div></div><div class="item-price">16.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Wi-Fi Milanesa de Pollo</div></div><div class="item-price">16.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Wi-Fi Pollo Mechado</div></div><div class="item-price">16.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Wi-Fi Carne Mechada</div></div><div class="item-price">16.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Wi-Fi Lomo de Cerdo</div></div><div class="item-price">16.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Doble Wi-Fi</div><div class="item-desc">2 Proteínas a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">22.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Doble Wi-Fi</div><div class="item-desc">4 Proteínas a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">30.000$</div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- PERROS CALIENTES -->

  <section class="section" id="hotdogs">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="section-icon">🌭</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Perros Calientes</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Hot Dog Sencillo</div></div><div class="item-price">7.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Hot Dog Pollo Mechado</div></div><div class="item-price">12.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Hot Dog Carne Mechada</div></div><div class="item-price">12.000$</div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- BURRITOS -->

  <section class="section" id="burritos">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="section-icon">🌯</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Burritos</h2>
    </div>
    <p class="section-note">Todos incluyen: Lechuga · Tomate · Cebolla · Jamón · Queso amarillo · Tocineta · Huevo · Papas fritas · Salsas</p>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Burrito</div><div class="item-desc">+ 1 Proteína a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">17.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Burrito</div><div class="item-desc">+ 2 Proteínas a elegir</div></div><div class="item-price">22.000$</div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- MOROCHO -->

  <section class="section" id="morocho">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="section-icon">🥙</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Morocho</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="combo-card">
      <div class="combo-badge">Normal</div>
      <div class="combo-name">Morocho Normal</div>
      <div class="combo-includes">
        <span>Pan de perro · Vegetales · Pollo mechado</span>
        <span>Carne mechada · Salchicha · Jamón · Queso</span>
        <span>Huevo · Papas fritas · Salsa</span>
      </div>
      <div class="combo-price">22.000$</div>
    </div>
    <div class="combo-card">
      <div class="combo-badge">⭐ Especial</div>
      <div class="combo-name">Morocho Especial</div>
      <div class="combo-includes">
        <span>Pan de perro · Vegetales · Pollo mechado</span>
        <span>Carne mechada · Salchicha · Lomo de cerdo</span>
        <span>Chorizo · Jamón · Queso · Huevo · Papas fritas · Salsa</span>
      </div>
      <div class="combo-price">28.000$</div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ESPECIALES -->

  <section class="section" id="especiales">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="section-icon">⭐</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Especiales</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="combo-card">
      <div class="combo-badge">Especialidad</div>
      <div class="combo-name">Granjero</div>
      <div class="combo-includes">
        <span>1 Proteína a elegir</span>
        <span>Pollo Mechado · Carne Mechada · Pollo Crispy · Lomo de Cerdo · Milanesa</span>
      </div>
      <div class="combo-price">18.000$</div>
    </div>
    <div class="combo-card">
      <div class="combo-badge">Club</div>
      <div class="combo-name">Club House</div>
      <div class="combo-includes">
        <span>Lechuga · Tomate · Cebolla · Huevo</span>
        <span>Pollo Mechado · Jamón · Queso</span>
        <span>Papas Fritas</span>
      </div>
      <div class="combo-price">25.000$</div>
    </div>
    <div class="combo-card">
      <div class="combo-badge">🤝 Para Compartir</div>
      <div class="combo-name">La Picada</div>
      <div class="combo-includes">
        <span>Carne · Pollo · Chorizo</span>
        <span>Ensalada · Queso · Papas fritas · Salsas</span>
      </div>
      <div class="combo-price">30.000$</div>
    </div>
    <div class="section-header" style="padding-top:8px;">
      <span class="section-icon">🥗</span>
      <h2 class="section-title" style="font-size:22px;">Ensaladas</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Ensalada César</div></div><div class="item-price">14.000$</div></div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Ensalada César + Pollo Crispy</div></div><div class="item-price">18.000$</div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- PAPAS -->

  <section class="section" id="papas">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="section-icon">🍟</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Papas</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-item"><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">Salchipapa</div><div class="item-desc">Papas fritas · Salchicha · Queso amarillo</div></div><div class="item-price">13.000$</div></div>

<script>
  function show(id, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
    btn.classList.add('active');
    // Scroll tab into view
    btn.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
    // Scroll to top of content
    window.scrollTo({ top: document.querySelector('.nav-wrap').offsetTop - 10, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }
</script>
